claim: disrobe unpacks PE packers (UPX, ASPack, PECompact, MEW, kkrunchy, Yoda's Crypter) through its own stub emulator and recovers section bytes that are byte-identical to the committed original, with no external tool participating.

oracle.external: byte-identity against the committed known-good original PE (RVA-aligned), plus stub-emulator round-trip equivalence

reproduce: cargo run -p disrobe-bench-native-unpack  (CI gates: cargo test -p disrobe-pass-native --test upx_unpack_all)
title: Native packer unpack, byte-identity vs the original PE
